def __setattr__(self, name: str, val: Any) -> None:  # pyre-ignore
    if name.startswith("COMPUTED_"):
        if name in self:
            old_val = self[name]
            if old_val == val:
                return
            raise KeyError(
                "Computed attributed '{}' already exists "
                "with a different value! old={}, new={}.".format(name, old_val, val)
            )
        self[name] = val
    else:
        super().__setattr__(name, val)
